name: HivePunk 547
subject: Letta
thesis: Letta appears to have shifted its active work from the older letta-ai/letta repository to letta-ai/letta-code, so judging its current momentum from that old repository alone would be misleading. Its value rests on memory-first agent claims that the supplied pages assert but do not independently benchmark.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: letta-ai/letta has 0 raw commits in the last 30 days, 0 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.missing: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Letta is described as a platform for stateful agents with memory that can learn and self-improve over time.
claims.quote: Platform for stateful agents: AI with advanced memory that can learn and self-improve over time.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Letta was formerly known as MemGPT.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Letta says its current source code lives in letta-ai/letta-code and includes the agent harness, interactive terminal UI, App Server, channels, and runtime.
claims.quote: The current source code lives in letta-ai/letta-code , which includes the agent harness, interactive terminal UI, App Server, channels, and the runtime used by the desktop and web apps.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The archive branch contains the retired Letta V1 API server.
claims.quote: The archive branch contains the retired Letta V1 API server.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Letta documentation says Letta agents learn from experience and improve with use.
claims.quote: Letta agents learn from experience and improve with use.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Letta documentation says the Letta Code harness is fully open source.
claims.quote: The Letta Code harness is fully open source and builds on our lab’s latest research in AI memory and continual learning.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Letta describes itself as an AI research lab in San Francisco building machines that learn.
claims.quote: Letta is an AI research lab in San Francisco building machines that learn.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Letta says its agents can self-improve through sleep-time compute without needing model updates.
claims.quote: Agents self-improve through sleep-time compute , learning without needing model updates.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Letta says all context such as skills and prompts is git-tracked through MemFS.
claims.quote: All context (skills, prompts, etc.) is git-tracked through MemFS .

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: letta-ai/letta has 0 raw commits in the last 30 days, 0 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: Zero commits in letta-ai/letta do not by themselves show Letta has stopped shipping, because Letta says current code lives in letta-ai/letta-code and the old archive branch is retired.
claims.math: c10 shows 0 commits in the old repo; c3 locates current code in letta-ai/letta-code; c4 says the archive branch holds the retired V1 server; therefore old-repo inactivity is consistent with a repository migration.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether letta-ai/letta is still shipping, as a repository in its own right.
claims.missing: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.

risks: The older letta-ai/letta repository had 0 raw commits in the last 30 days in the supplied check, so its activity does not show current shipping.
Current development is said to live elsewhere, in letta-ai/letta-code, which was not supplied as a page to verify.
Claims about learning and memory improvement are presented by Letta itself; no independent benchmark results are shown in the pages.
Model, pricing, limits and data-retention details for Letta Cloud are not stated in the pages supplied.
Security posture, audit and vulnerability history are not stated in the pages supplied.
unknowns: Whether letta-ai/letta is still shipping: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.
Whether letta-ai/letta is still shipping, as a repository in its own right.: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.
wouldChangeMind: Evidence that letta-ai/letta-code is inactive or abandoned would change the thesis toward Letta having stopped shipping.
Independent benchmarks contradicting Letta's memory and continual-learning claims would change the thesis toward scepticism.
Audited security, pricing, retention or usage data contradicting the pages supplied would change the thesis on risk and traction.
